item.title: The Analytic Signal
item.description: This post focuses on the analytic signal. The analytic-signal view is central in communications, radar, controls, and physics-based signal analysis because it separates amplitude and phase behavior in a mathematically clean way. The word “analytic” here is not a coincidence of terminology — it’s the same complex-analysis concept from a math methods course, applied on the time axis instead of the spatial or complex-variable axis it’s usually introduced with. This post builds the signal-processing machinery first, then closes the loop back to complex analysis to show why the name fits.
